question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.customer_id,
        cs.first_payment_date,
        cs.total_ltv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= cs.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as amount_7_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= cs.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as amount_30_days
    FROM customer_stats cs
    JOIN payment p ON cs.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY cs.customer_id, cs.first_payment_date, cs.total_ltv
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(100.0 * amount_7_days / total_ltv), 2) as avg_pct_7_days,
    ROUND(AVG(100.0 * amount_30_days / total_ltv), 2) as avg_pct_30_days,
    ROUND(AVG(total_ltv), 2) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_periods

WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.customer_id,
        cs.first_payment_date,
        cs.total_ltv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= cs.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as amount_7_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= cs.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as amount_30_days
    FROM customer_stats cs
    JOIN payment p ON cs.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY cs.customer_id, cs.first_payment_date, cs.total_ltv
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(100.0 * amount_7_days / total_ltv), 2) as avg_pct_7_days,
    ROUND(AVG(100.0 * amount_30_days / total_ltv), 2) as avg_pct_30_days,
    ROUND(AVG(total_ltv), 2) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_periods
